title: Auto Glass Services Appointment Terms: Booking, Mobile Service and Rescheduling
content:
Appointment terms of **Auto Glass Services**, Crestline Collision & Glass. They govern how far ahead a glass appointment is booked, when a job is done at the customer's location, how many times and until when the customer may reschedule, and when the network itself moves a mobile job for weather.

## Clause 1 — Booking

An appointment is booked at least the tier's minimum booking lead in hours and at most the tier's booking horizon in calendar days ahead, same-day only where the tier's same-day booking setting is true.

## Clause 2 — Mobile service

A mobile job is offered only where the tier's mobile service setting is true and the vehicle is within the tier's mobile radius of the center, with an arrival window of the tier's arrival window in hours and the tier's technician time in minutes booked.

## Clause 3 — Customer reschedules

3.1 The customer may reschedule up to the tier's number of reschedules allowed. The count is the number of reschedules on the job, over its whole life, whose cause is the customer's request.

3.2 The reschedule request is made at least the tier's reschedule cutoff hours before the scheduled appointment start. The cutoff is the appointment start minus the cutoff hours, counted in full 60-minute hours, and a request exactly at the cutoff is in time.

3.3 Clause 3.2 is judged on the company's records for that job: the appointment date and start slot the job currently carries, against the current time when the request is made. A request made at the cutoff or earlier is in time; a request made after the cutoff is not.

## Clause 4 — Weather

A mobile job whose forecast temperature at the appointment is below the tier's lowest mobile temperature, or with rain forecast, is rescheduled by the network with the cause recorded as weather; weather reschedules are never counted against the customer and carry no cutoff.

## Effect of a reschedule

A reschedule, whether at the customer's request or for weather, replaces the job's appointment date and start slot with the new ones.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures)

Take a job whose appointment starts at 10:00 on a given day, on a tier whose reschedule cutoff is, for this illustration, 4 hours. The cutoff is 06:00 on the appointment day — the start less 4 full 60-minute hours.

| Request made at | Relation to the 06:00 cutoff | In time under Clause 3.2 |
|---|---|---|
| 05:59 on the appointment day | before the cutoff | Yes |
| 06:00 on the appointment day | exactly at the cutoff | Yes |
| 06:01 on the appointment day | after the cutoff | No |

With a cutoff of 24 hours instead, and the same 10:00 start, the cutoff falls at 10:00 on the day before the appointment; a request at that moment is in time, and one at 10:01 that day is not.

## Counting cases (hypothetical)

On a tier allowing 2 reschedules, a job that has been moved once for weather and once at the customer's request has a count of 1: the weather move is not counted. A second customer request brings the count to 2, which is within the allowance; the allowance is then used up.

A mobile job whose forecast at the appointment is exactly the tier's lowest mobile temperature, with no rain forecast, is not below it, so Clause 4 does not move it on temperature grounds.
